method: LOBSTER 5.1.1 on QE all-PAW(kjpaw) SCF+NSCF (nosym, nbnd460, wf_collect). MINIMAL LOBSTER basis (Li 1s2s; B/O 2s2p; P/S/Cl 3s3p) -> Li-X underestimated vs extended-basis modelc.

headline.new_strong_bonds: B-S -7.57 (thioborate BS3) + P-O -8.56 (phosphate) = new covalent bonds from B2O3; B-S stronger than host P-S
headline.host_unchanged: P-S -6.11 ~ modelc -6.00 -> B2O3 leaves the PS4 backbone intact

caveat: Li-S/Li-Cl underestimated (minimal Li basis 1s2s). For apples-to-apples Li-X vs modelc, rerun LOBSTER only (no DFT redo) with extended basis: basisfunctions Li 1s 2s 2p / P S Cl 3s 3p 3d.
